# Trusted reviewers: one list for three things (docs/release-flow.md "Trusted reviewers").
# - `/nightly 2640 2642` picks the pull requests the Nightly holds (tools/ci/nightly_set.py);
# - `/close`, `/reopen`, `/label`, `/unlabel` triage issues and pull requests (tools/ci/triage_command.py);
# - `/unclaim @login` releases someone else's claim, and listed reviewers have no claim limit (tools/ci/claim_command.py).
# One reviewer per line: `<numeric GitHub ID> <login>`, with who added it and when. The ID decides; the login is only
# for people reading this file and for messages. A login is a name anyone can claim once its owner renames or deletes
# the account; an ID is never reused. Get it with `gh api users/<login> --jq .id`, or run
# `python3 tools/ci/resolve_reviewer_ids.py` to fill in the IDs and `--check` to catch renames.
# A line in any other form (a bare login included) grants nothing. Ludovic is always allowed (OWNER_ID in
# tools/ci/nightly_set.py) and isn't listed. Removing a line revokes that account at once. A line with only `paused`
# stops all three for every reviewer (Ludovic's still work).
